title: Odnalezienie artefaktu
description: Powolny najazd w kamiennej komnacie. Van dostrzega na piedestale ciemny, nienumerowany dwudziestościenny artefakt i ostrożnie zbliża do niego dłoń. Bez cyfr i bez zmiany lokacji.

prompts.image: Exact edit of revision 1: preserve the complete shot and reduce only the unnumbered artifact to canonical size, exactly 3.0 cm vertex-to-vertex and about 2.5 cm face-to-face, slightly larger than a normal tabletop D20 and tiny relative to Van and the pedestal. Exact emerald and aged-gold material, no numerals.
prompts.animation: One continuous 4-second discovery shot. Slow controlled dolly from Van toward the pedestal as he stops, fixes his gaze on the small 3 cm artifact and cautiously approaches by one step. Torch flame and reflections move naturally; the artifact remains inert and unnumbered. Preserve identity, anatomy, wardrobe, architecture, geometry and canonical scale. No traps, new people, morphing, cuts, digits, captions, logos or watermark.
